english: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be real numbers in $\left(0,\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$ such that $\alpha+\beta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$. Then the minimum value of $\left(1+24\,\mathrm{cosec}^2\alpha\right)\left(1+2\,\mathrm{cosec}^2\beta\right)$ is ______.
hindi: माना $\alpha$ तथा $\beta$, $\left(0,\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$ में ऐसी वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं कि $\alpha+\beta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ है। तब $\left(1+24\,\mathrm{cosec}^2\alpha\right)\left(1+2\,\mathrm{cosec}^2\beta\right)$ का न्यूनतम मान ______ है।
solution_full: From $\alpha+\beta=\dfrac\pi2$: $\mathrm{cosec}\,\beta=\dfrac{1}{\sin\left(\frac\pi2-\alpha\right)}=\sec\alpha$, so the expression is $\left(1+24\,\mathrm{cosec}^2\alpha\right)\left(1+2\sec^2\alpha\right)$ with $\alpha\in\left(0,\dfrac\pi2\right)$.
Let $t=\tan^2\alpha$, which takes every value in $(0,\infty)$. Then $\mathrm{cosec}^2\alpha=1+\cot^2\alpha=1+\dfrac1t$ and $\sec^2\alpha=1+t$.
$50t$ and $\dfrac{72}{t}$ are positive with constant product $3600$, so by AM-GM $50t+\dfrac{72}{t}\ge2\sqrt{3600}=120$.
Equality holds iff $50t=\dfrac{72}{t}$, i.e. $t^2=\dfrac{36}{25}$, $t=\dfrac65$; this corresponds to $\tan\alpha=\sqrt{\dfrac65}$, a valid $\alpha$, with $\beta=\dfrac\pi2-\alpha$.
The minimum value is $123+120=243$. (Guessing the symmetric point $\alpha=\beta=\dfrac\pi4$ gives $49\cdot5=245$, which is not the minimum.)
originality_note: New: a product of two trigonometric factors with unequal weights under the constraint alpha + beta = pi/2 collapses, after t = tan^2 alpha, to 123 + 50t + 72/t; the unequal weights move the optimum away from pi/4 (way 5: complementary-angle constraint linked with AM-GM). Closest known: '(1 + 1/sin^n a)(1 + 1/cos^n a) is least at pi/4'. Different because: the coefficients 24 and 2 break the symmetry, so the symmetric guess gives 245, not the minimum 243.
blueprint_concepts: Arithmetic Mean (AM), Geometric Mean (GM) & AM-GM Inequality: maximising / minimising expressions under a constraint
Maximum and minimum of general trigonometric expressions under constraints

concept_use.Arithmetic Mean (AM), Geometric Mean (GM: AM-GM on 50t + 72/t >= 120 with equality at t = 6/5 gives the minimum.
concept_use.Maximum and minimum of general trigonome: The constraint alpha + beta = pi/2 turns cosec beta into sec alpha, and t = tan^2 alpha turns the trigonometric product into a rational function of t.
